patches.name: owned-root
patches.reason: createRoot() parents the root scope to Effection global. useRoot() acquires the tree as a resource owned by the calling scope, which is the surface this repository uses; createRoot(owner) is the escape hatch behind it.

patches.name: owned-root
patches.reason: NodeImpl takes the owning scope a parentless root is created under.

patches.name: containment-removal
patches.reason: useFocus()'s remove middleware compared the removed node with the focused one. Closing a drawer or panel removes the branch above the focused control, which left focus on a node that no longer existed; it now asks whether the branch contains the focused node.
